worked_solution:
Both the numerator and denominator approach $\infty $ as $x\to \infty .$ However, since ${e}^{x}≫{x}^{5}$ for large values of $x,$ the numerator is growing much faster than the denominator. Consequently, we conclude that

$$
{lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{{e}^{x}}{{x}^{5}}=\infty .
$$
